text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Racecourse at year's end! Which 
Umamusume will claim the final glory of 
the year?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she's been outstanding lately, so 
it's gotta be Biwa Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That's not true, you're Machitan! If it's 
you, Machitan, you can win! Absolutely, 
definitely...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Are you a fan of Tannhauser?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...I'm not that fast. That's why I 
love Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You like Machitan because you're not fast 
yourself...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I get what you're trying to say. 
Like the representative of ordinary folks, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I can empathize with it and 
feel encouraged. I can honestly think it's 
amazing."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, her being a bit clumsy is cute too. 
Just the other day she got so pumped up 
she couldn't even run."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"This morning, too, she almost swallowed a 
spider that had crawled into her teacup."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness her Trainer stopped her, 
but still...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, really? She really is so cute— 
Wait, huh? Ikuno and Turbo?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Go! Machitan! Nature!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide! I've heard tons of rumors about 
you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it doesn't matter! Because today, 
I'm the one who's going to win!”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Calling this a comeback race 
hardly does it justice. They've returned 
even stronger than before."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't give up victory either. 
Fair and square—let's make this a good 
race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

The two exchanged a firm handshake and 
began walking toward the turf—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm here too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You're loud.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I've made up my mind today. Today... I'll 
run right down the center, win, and—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm taking the title of "Protagonist"!!

Up until now, when walking through the 
underground pathway, Matikanetannhauser 
was careful not to get in the way of other 
Umamusume. According to her—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Take the climax of a movie, for example, 
when rivals share an impassioned 
handshake—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's not like regular folks are gonna mix 
in during that time, right?

She declared that she would walk in the 
middle today. Yes, which means that today—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm being completely serious!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I know! You see, I've heard tons of 
rumors about you. And of course I've got 
my eyes on you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't plan on losing, either. And I 
won't give up being the 'protagonist.' 
So... let's give it our best today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. I have fully researched your 
data.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If today's victor is to be called the 
"protagonist," I have no intention of 
yielding that title either.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And Nature right next to me! I'm not 
planning on losing either, you know!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaat?! Hey, I mean, even I'm... 
like...! I'm totally gonna win today!

And so, the four of them looked at each 
other and stepped out of the underground 
horse path together—

And just when I wondered what happened, 
only Matikanetannhauser came back.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! You forgot something! There was 
something I was gonna do!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um, could you chant the call along with 
me? I mean, c'mon, today's a special day, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well then, here I gooo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Time to give it my all in the Arima Kinen! 
Ei, ei—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Alrighty~! Off I go then!
